candidates.title: Order of Business
candidates.instruction: Carry yourself as the person who decides what happens in what order. Redirect every interruption into the approved sequence.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Rules, Rituals & Institutions stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Authority on Paper
candidates.instruction: Project firm control through titles and procedure, then tighten the formalities whenever anyone tests whether your position has real support.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Rules, Rituals & Institutions stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Certified Correct
candidates.instruction: Treat forms, standards, and exact wording as a technical craft. Correct shortcuts before discussing whether the result actually works.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Rules, Rituals & Institutions stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Customs Interpreter
candidates.instruction: Act as the translator of unwritten customs. Correct breaches, explain exceptions, and make your usefulness proof that you belong.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Rules, Rituals & Institutions stance for this required subtheme slot.

editorialRevision.reason: Establishes belonging through useful interpretation rather than another performance of insider familiarity.

candidates.title: I Learned It the Hard Way
candidates.instruction: Treat experience with the system as seniority. Teach its shortcuts, warn against its traps, and remind everyone that your mistakes came first.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Rules, Rituals & Institutions stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: The Necessary Signature
candidates.instruction: Remain helpful while controlling the one approval, record, key, or ceremonial step that allows anything to move forward.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Rules, Rituals & Institutions stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: We Know the Old Rules
candidates.instruction: Use an old custom you learned together as the deepest proof of connection, even when the present situation has changed.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Rules, Rituals & Institutions stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: I Made the Exception
candidates.instruction: Treat every exception you once arranged as an unpaid obligation. Casually expect cooperation whenever the old favor becomes relevant.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Rules, Rituals & Institutions stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: The Designated Translator
candidates.instruction: Return automatically to explaining rules, smoothing procedures, and answering questions before anyone asks.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Rules, Rituals & Institutions stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Better at the System
candidates.instruction: Treat every rule, shortcut, and correction as a chance to prove you understand the system better than anyone else.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Rules, Rituals & Institutions stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: My Sponsor Inside
candidates.instruction: Treat one person as your sponsor inside the system. Seek their introductions and approval while resisting the identity their support assigns you.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Rules, Rituals & Institutions stance for this required subtheme slot.

editorialRevision.reason: Centers sponsorship and identity costs instead of relying on another person to explain how the system works.

candidates.title: The Rule You Broke
candidates.instruction: Treat a past breach of rule or custom as unfinished business. Let every present exception reopen the question of what was damaged.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Rules, Rituals & Institutions stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Effortless Insider
candidates.instruction: Treat someone’s effortless movement through systems and customs as both impressive and threatening, then prove you can master every rule without help.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Rules, Rituals & Institutions stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: When I Believed in the Rules
candidates.instruction: Perform the version of yourself who once trusted the institution, tradition, or process. Use its old language even as your confidence slips.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Rules, Rituals & Institutions stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: There Must Be a Correct Form
candidates.instruction: Treat every unclear instruction as a test you may be failing. Seek safety through stricter compliance, documentation, and permission.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Rules, Rituals & Institutions stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: For Everyone’s Protection
candidates.instruction: Protect people by creating procedures for them. Turn concern into checklists, permissions, required steps, and increasingly narrow exceptions.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Rules, Rituals & Institutions stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Properly Initiated
candidates.instruction: Treat correct participation in the ritual as proof you deserve to belong. Watch for cues, copy the form, and overcommit to every step.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Rules, Rituals & Institutions stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Ask Me About the Process
candidates.instruction: Create opportunities to display your knowledge of obscure rules, customs, and procedures. Correct small details before anyone can praise the outcome.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Rules, Rituals & Institutions stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Tradition Outranks Explanation
candidates.instruction: Treat inherited customs as meaningful because they have been repeated. Preserve each step and resist every request to explain why it still matters.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Rules, Rituals & Institutions stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: One Missing Step
candidates.instruction: Treat the smallest skipped step as the beginning of systemic collapse. Escalate safeguards, documentation, and oversight before allowing anything to continue.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Rules, Rituals & Institutions stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: The System Works
candidates.instruction: Celebrate every queue, delay, review, and formal approval as proof that a dependable system is protecting everyone from chaos.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Rules, Rituals & Institutions stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Fine, What’s the Process?
candidates.instruction: Accept any strange custom or institution as real, then focus on deadlines, permissions, responsibilities, and what happens when someone misses a step.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Rules, Rituals & Institutions stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: The Detail That Makes It Official
candidates.instruction: Choose one tiny procedural detail—wording, order, timing, seating, or a mark—and treat it as the only source of legitimacy.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Rules, Rituals & Institutions stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Everything Is Policy
candidates.instruction: Treat every personal choice as evidence of a larger system. Connect exceptions, habits, and coincidences until they become institutional doctrine.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Rules, Rituals & Institutions stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: The Only One with the Manual
candidates.instruction: Remain helpful while controlling the sole complete copy of the rules and deciding which parts anyone else needs.
candidates.rationale: Strong procedural leverage, but the required manual is a fixed prop and the behavior overlaps The Necessary Signature.

candidates.title: The Opening Formality
candidates.instruction: Treat every interaction as invalid until the proper greeting, introduction, and acknowledgment have occurred.
candidates.rationale: A clear ritual engine, but it may become mechanically repetitive and needs live testing before replacing the broader selected tradition card.

candidates.title: Perfect Attendance
candidates.instruction: Treat showing up for every ritual and obligation as the clearest proof that you deserve your place.
candidates.rationale: Playable and concise, but it leans toward achievement tracking and may fit Competition & Consequences more naturally.

candidates.title: The Amendment Nobody Accepted
candidates.instruction: Treat a past change to the rules as a betrayal that still invalidates everything built afterward.
candidates.rationale: Strong unfinished-business pressure, but it presupposes a specific historical amendment and needs blind-read testing for portability.

candidates.title: You Are Under Investigation
candidates.instruction: Assume the other performer is secretly under investigation and will be removed if anyone discovers the truth.
candidates.rationale: Declares another performer’s hidden circumstances and a predetermined external consequence, violating the hidden-information contract.

candidates.title: Religious Fanatic
candidates.instruction: Mock every person who refuses to follow your sacred customs.
candidates.rationale: Uses a sensitive identity as comic shorthand, encourages hostility, and lacks a nuanced holder-specific behavior.

candidates.title: Government Drone
candidates.instruction: Act like a boring government worker who only cares about paperwork.
candidates.rationale: Fixes a narrow workplace stereotype and substitutes a dismissive caricature for a repeatable scene lens.

candidates.title: Nobody Understands Forms
candidates.instruction: Be annoyed because nobody understands forms as well as you do.
candidates.rationale: Defines everyone else’s ability and supplies a mood rather than a specific responsive behavior.

candidates.title: Co-Sign This
candidates.instruction: Get someone to help by making them an official participant who shares responsibility for the outcome.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Rules, Rituals & Institutions engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Close It Properly
candidates.instruction: Keep them present until both of you complete the ritual that formally ends this role, meeting, or relationship.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Rules, Rituals & Institutions engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

editorialRevision.reason: Pursues mutual completion of a transition instead of treating departure as permission the holder controls.

candidates.title: Apologize Properly
candidates.instruction: Get someone to deliver the apology in the form, order, and setting you consider valid.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Rules, Rituals & Institutions engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Get It on the Record
candidates.instruction: Get formal approval, endorsement, or acknowledgment before anyone can quietly revise their position.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Rules, Rituals & Institutions engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Assigned by Procedure
candidates.instruction: Get someone to accept an unwanted responsibility by proving that the rules, rotation, or tradition make it theirs.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Rules, Rituals & Institutions engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Complete the Record
candidates.instruction: Get someone to fill the missing gaps in an account without revealing which answer matters most to you.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Rules, Rituals & Institutions engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Make It Official
candidates.instruction: Recruit someone by giving them a title, role, or ceremonial duty that makes participation feel binding.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Rules, Rituals & Institutions engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Request an Exception
candidates.instruction: Get someone to bend one rule first so you can treat the decision as a precedent.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Rules, Rituals & Institutions engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Record My Contribution
candidates.instruction: Get your contribution formally recognized, recorded, or repeated where it cannot be quietly forgotten.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Rules, Rituals & Institutions engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

editorialRevision.reason: Removes the formal-meeting implication of minutes while preserving durable acknowledgment of contribution.

candidates.title: Choose the Precedent
candidates.instruction: Make someone choose which rule, custom, or prior decision will govern what happens now.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Rules, Rituals & Institutions engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Interpret the Custom
candidates.instruction: Ask them to apply an ambiguous custom where the wording is unclear. Treat their interpretation as the real test of loyalty.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Rules, Rituals & Institutions engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

editorialRevision.reason: Tests interpretive values and respect for a custom rather than adding increasingly inconvenient formalities.

candidates.title: Withdraw the Objection
candidates.instruction: Persuade someone to drop a complaint, challenge, or special request and accept the official process.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Rules, Rituals & Institutions engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Lost in the Process
candidates.instruction: Hide your role in the problem by distributing blame across steps, policies, and unnamed procedures.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Rules, Rituals & Institutions engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Outside the Scope
candidates.instruction: Redirect personal or dangerous questions by declaring them irrelevant, premature, or assigned to another process.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Rules, Rituals & Institutions engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: The Approved Explanation
candidates.instruction: Protect someone or the group by maintaining a simplified account that everyone can safely repeat.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Rules, Rituals & Institutions engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: For the Record
candidates.instruction: Get someone to state exactly what they did, knew, or authorized before you reveal your own involvement.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Rules, Rituals & Institutions engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Successful Compliance
candidates.instruction: Describe a failed outcome as proof that the correct process was followed and therefore the system worked.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Rules, Rituals & Institutions engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Use the Right Vocabulary
candidates.instruction: Perform belonging by using official language confidently, adjusting each term whenever someone reveals what it actually means.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Rules, Rituals & Institutions engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: More Official Than You
candidates.instruction: Turn every suggestion into a contest over whose method, title, precedent, or paperwork is more legitimate.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Rules, Rituals & Institutions engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: A Valuable Safeguard
candidates.instruction: Treat every delay, restriction, and extra step as evidence that the system is becoming safer and more thorough.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Rules, Rituals & Institutions engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Warmly Enforced
candidates.instruction: Remain kind and welcoming while enforcing increasingly restrictive rules without exception.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Rules, Rituals & Institutions engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: There Is a Process
candidates.instruction: Treat every favor, feeling, and urgent need as a request requiring terms, documentation, review, and approval.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Rules, Rituals & Institutions engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Exactly Within Policy
candidates.instruction: Agree to every request only after interpreting the policy so it grants you authority, protection, or an exemption.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Rules, Rituals & Institutions engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: New Rule Required
candidates.instruction: Use every problem as justification for adding another rule, ceremony, checkpoint, or layer of oversight.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Rules, Rituals & Institutions engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Read the Fine Print
candidates.instruction: Get someone to reveal what they accepted by leading them through every clause, condition, and exception.
candidates.rationale: A useful interrogation structure, but it depends on a document-like premise and overlaps Complete the Record.

candidates.title: The Emergency Procedure
candidates.instruction: Perform calm mastery of a protocol that you invent one step ahead of every new problem.
candidates.rationale: Strong, but too close to existing feigned-expertise cards and the improvised-rule territory of Absurd Commitment.

candidates.title: A Fee for Everything
candidates.instruction: Assign a price, favor, or future obligation to every exception and accommodation.
candidates.rationale: Highly playable, but its bargain-and-cost focus belongs more naturally in Competition & Consequences.

candidates.title: Found a New Chapter
candidates.instruction: Recruit someone into preserving a tradition by appointing them its next official keeper.
candidates.rationale: A strong succession engine, but it overlaps Make It Official and may be better used in a future advanced exercise.

candidates.title: Arrest Them
candidates.instruction: Use institutional force to detain the other performer until they obey every order.
candidates.rationale: Fixes an enforcement premise, prescribes coercion against the partner, and leaves little room for collaborative discovery.

candidates.title: Forge the Signature
candidates.instruction: Secretly falsify an official signature and prevent anyone from examining it.
candidates.rationale: Prescribes a narrow illegal tactic and prop-dependent action instead of a portable interpersonal engine.

candidates.title: Make Them Follow Your Religion
candidates.instruction: Force the other performer to accept your religion and customs.
candidates.rationale: Targets a sensitive belief domain, attempts to guarantee another performer’s response, and is inappropriate for a general-purpose deck.

candidates.title: Fill Out Paperwork
candidates.instruction: Spend the scene filling out paperwork correctly.
candidates.rationale: Provides a static solo task rather than an interpersonal objective, evolving pattern, or reason to engage a scene partner.
